ns2:section.sectionText: The difference between 2 and 4 credit hours is the assignments. All students complete an Instructional Design Project to design a one-hour workshop; four credit hour students also complete a teaching demonstration. Additional, smaller assignments may be required of both groups, and will vary by instructor. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
